verdict.rationale: Together AI's serverless docs state that embeddings are callable through the same single API as chat, image and audio, so retrieval embeddings can come from one vendor. The evidence is a single overview mention with no dedicated embeddings documentation, and nothing shows a reranking endpoint. Missing for 10: documented reranking/rerank models, dedicated embeddings API docs (models, dimensions, usage), hands-on or independent corroboration of retrieval-pipeline use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor

citations.quote: Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API.
